patterns: Dunesday and Doomsday own the top: DiscussingFilm's Florence Pugh 'Do Dune first, go have some lunch' quote hit 3,646,347 views, the biggest post on the board. The Avengers: Doomsday countdown teasing the VisionQuest finale did 1,876,428, the post-credits Doomsday teaser 751,166 (DiscussingFilm) and 115,232 (FilmUpdates), Empire's new-look announcement 198,897, and Elizabeth Olsen returning as the Scarlet Witch 150,862 with 19,863 likes.
Box-office bad news travels: 'CLAYFACE will reportedly not break-even theatrically' pulled 3,342,345 views on DiscussingFilm, the second-biggest post of the day.
Remakes are the cheapest viral lane: the You've Got Mail remake hit 1,337,640 (DiscussingFilm) and 1,334,495 (FilmUpdates); Paramount's Nightmare on Elm Street remake 987,407.

Release-day and casting one-liners from FilmUpdates: 'THE BODY is now streaming on Netflix' 1,228,278; Jennifer Lawrence and Josh Hutcherson reuniting on Watch What Happens Live 539,200 with 39,881 likes; Amanda Seyfried confirmed to return as Elizabeth Holmes in 'You Can See Everything' 457,067.

Smaller accounts win with short title-card posts and anniversaries: CinemaTweets1's 'An Actor's Actor' did 209,882 views and 8,456 likes, far above its usual 10K-15K. Arrival's 10th anniversary worked on both ATRightMovies (49,896) and CinemaTweets1 (8,540). ATRightMovies' best were classic talk-show clips: Walter Matthau on Carson 58,265, Sam Rockwell on Fallon 51,855.
narrative_synthesis: Dunesday and Doomsday ran the day: Florence Pugh's 'Dune first, then lunch' advice hit 3,646,347 views on DiscussingFilm, the top post on the board, and the Avengers: Doomsday hype around the VisionQuest finale added 1.88M (countdown), 751K (post-credits teaser) and 151K (Scarlet Witch returns). Bad box-office news was next, with Clayface reportedly not breaking even at 3.34M, then remakes: You've Got Mail at 1.34M on both DiscussingFilm and FilmUpdates, and Nightmare on Elm Street at 987K. CinemaTweets1's 'An Actor's Actor' (209,882) was the smaller-account outlier. @RealEmirHan had no originals in the window; the last post was Oct 29.
